mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS drops > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) over 3 months signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO rises > 1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS drops > 100k in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a surge in demand for housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST rises > 10% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% quarter-over-quarter and the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, the combination signals a potential economic slowdown under tight monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: economic slowdown under tight monetary conditions
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ < 1% and FEDFUNDS > 4%.
